newsitem.title: USA: Kulicke added to S&P SmallCap 600.
newsitem.headline: Kulicke added to S&P SmallCap 600.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said Tuesday that Kulicke & Soffa Industries Inc will replace Fibreboard Corp in the S&P SmallCap 600 Index after the close of trading on June 26.
Fibreboard is being acquired by Owens Corning in a cash offer scheduled to expire on that date.

Kulicke & Soffa Industries is headquartered in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, and is the world's largest maker of semiconductor assembly equipment. Its products include computerized wire bonders used to attach fine wires to computer chips, the wires used by the bonders, dicing saws used to cut silicon wafers and micro tools used in precision applications.
S&P said the company will be added to the its SmallCap Equipment (Semiconductor) industry group in the Technology economic sector.
